title: Audit every Wave-1 plan for the W1-30 defect shape: verdicts resting on instrument-validity checks with no human-experience gate
population_searched: all 46 files in orchestration/plans/: 30 piece plans audited in detail (W1-00..W1-29 + W1-HUD-TOAST), 13 W1-30-tree files excluded by the brief, 2 COST plans classified out of scope, 1 BUILDER-EXECUTION-CONTRACT read as governing text
headline: No plan outside the W1-30 tree cites OWNER-DIRECTIVES-2026-08-14 or Ruling W1. 29 of 30 are Plan-State: satisfied against a bar that moved after they were approved. This is one unpropagated directive, not thirty separate problems.
verified_facts: corpus/70-visual/refs/modern/ holds exactly 131 files across 7 folders (43/24/22/13/12/9/8) - W1-30 R1's count is correct, and W1-24:124, W1-06:71 and W1-03 W9 still carry the pre-2026-08-06 premise

W1-08 weights 28+26+10+12+14+10=100 against a >=90 bar, so the 10-point naive row can score zero and the plan still passes; W1-29 has the same arithmetic but is protected by an explicit 'independent naive pass ... is not closure' clause
could_not_do: Did not read the reference items; every claim is checked against what the plans themselves say. Defects that may live in the corpus rather than the plan (W1-02 M68 one-still-per-border, W1-09's 55-weight denominator, W1-27's 5/60 tolerance) are flagged as corpus-level and are the natural successor piece.
Instrument-gate counts in the ratio column are approximate (counted as lettered/numbered acceptance rows); human-gate counts are exact.
Did not audit the W1-30 children individually - excluded by the brief and live with builders in flight.
